text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — AtlasGrocers wants to run a 3-week POC. Needs near-realtime product categorization (streaming), nightly bulk embeddings for search, and function/tool-calls for price lookups. Also asked for a ballpark cost for 10M tokens/month and SOC2 + KMS details.

Leo Zhang: 👍 can do streaming + embeddings. question: do they need private (VPC) or is hosted ok for POC?

Priya Rao: They said hosted is fine for now but security team will send a questionnaire. Prefer Dedicated for perf if pricing ok. Asking if we can provide ephemeral dedicated for the trial.

Samira Patel: Re: pricing — for 10M tokens/month across gen + embeddings, rough hosted estimate: $X/token-gen tier + $Y/embedding. I'll ping finance for a slab quote. Also, Dedicated trial is usually possible as a time-limited seat — @Nate (Eng) can confirm infra ops constraints.

Nate (Eng): We can spin a small Reserved pool for 3 weeks (2 GPUs) but need 48h lead time. Also we can enable KMS-backed key for model logs. There are a couple items in the security checklist we'll need answered (IP allowlist, data retention limits).

Priya Rao: Sec team sent the questionnaire PDF. I'm attaching the key asks here: SOC2 status, KMS support, on-demand / time-limited dedicated, data egress controls, logs retention window. Anyone can drop short answers?

sec-bot: Automated reply: SOC2 Type II — in progress; SOC2 report available upon NDA. KMS: integrates with customer-managed keys (via KMS/HSM). Private deploy: supported. See https://redwood.example.com/security-docs

Leo Zhang: For integration: share this streaming SDK snippet with the customer for structured output + function call. They want product JSON with fields: sku, category_id, category_path, confidence.

Leo Zhang: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key="<REDACTED>")

# Streaming with tool-call for price lookup
with client.stream("predict", model="redwood-gen-2") as s:
    s.send({
        "input": "Categorize: 'Organic Fuji Apple'",
        "features": {"structured": True, "tool_calls": ["price_lookup"]}
    })
    for chunk in s.iter_chunks():
        print(chunk.text)

# Example tool binding (server-side) returns JSON object from price service
```

Priya Rao: Nice. Can we also show a short example of the structured output we return (the customer wants deterministic schema to map into their catalog).

Nate (Eng): Example response payload (we typically emit a single JSON blob as the final event):

Leo Zhang: ```json
{
  "sku": "APL-FUJ-123",
  "category_id": "1002",
  "category_path": ["Produce","Fruits","Apples"],
  "confidence": 0.92,
  "price": {"value": 1.49, "currency": "USD", "source": "price_lookup"}
}
```

Samira Patel: Good. Also call out that we support schema validation on the response and will fail the request if shape doesn't match (configurable). That helps their integration testing.

Priya Rao: Atlas security asks whether PII is stored. We need a canned reply: PII not retained beyond retention window unless customer opts in, and logs can be scrubbed.

sec-bot: Automated reply: Default retention 30 days for logs; adjustable via contract. Customer-managed key option ensures data unreadable without KMS key. PII handling is configurable — we support redaction hooks and prefix caching controls.

Priya Rao: Final ask from Atlas: can we demo end-to-end (streaming categorization -> tool price lookup -> write to S3) next Wed? They want a runbook and a sample terraform snippet for access.

Nate (Eng): Yes. I'll prepare a runbook + ephemeral creds step-by-step. ETA EOD Friday for runbook draft. Need Atlas contact and IP ranges.

Priya Rao: I'll collect contact + questionnaire answers. Samira — can you send the preliminary price range by tomorrow morning?

Samira Patel: On it. sending numbers by 10am PST.

Leo Zhang: I'll produce a minimal sample repo link and a streaming demo video.

Priya Rao: Awesome — thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for handoff. :sparkles:
